primary_contract.fact: FreeThreadCount is process resource limit minus its current thread count. Nonzero subtype is rejected before resolving the process handle.
CreateThread reserves one thread resource before object allocation. Reservation failure is LimitReached; object allocation failure is OutOfResource. Start does not reserve again.
PostDestroy releases one current thread resource. Exit releases only a reservation hint; an exited object with an open handle still consumes current count.
Current-value and hint-value release accounting are distinct.
Main-thread startup reserves a thread resource before initialization.
Kernel module1: LimitReached132=0x10801; OutOfResource103=0xce01; OutOfHandles105=0xd201; InvalidCombination116=0xe801; InvalidHandle114=0xe401.

model.kind: Explicit diagnostic-host per-process guest-thread object quota, not a measured Switch budget or available macOS thread count.
model.configurability: Compile-time source constant; no environment or production test knob.
model.rationale: The inherited backend allocates an8MiB native stack for each created guest thread.128 retained objects bounds that diagnostic object population at roughly1GiB of stack-address reservation at steady state; main uses its existing native stack. This is not a resident-memory guarantee or a promise that native allocation cannot fail earlier.
counted: Every valid CreateThread reserves before calloc/condition/pthread allocation.
Created-not-started and started/live objects retain one reservation.
Exited objects with an open handle retain their reservation.
Closed-handle live objects retain their reservation until real host-thread exit/finalization.
model.release: thr_free under the existing global G lock unlinks the object, releases exactly one reservation and frees its condition/object. Native detached pthread and TLS cleanup then complete normally.
model.not_counted: Auxiliary native frontend/Metal/preemption/diagnostic pthreads are outside the guest-thread namespace.
model.atomicity: Quota admission, publication/handle reservation, cleanup and free-count observation use G. Capacity checks keep the unsigned counter in0..128; no unbounded arithmetic or free-handle substitution.
model.close_before_start: CloseHandle marks closed and signals the existing worker condition. The actual detached worker observes !started&&closed and performs host-only exit/finalization without entering the authored/native or game entry.
model.native_failure: Allocation/condition/attribute/pthread failures return OutOfResource and roll back reservation, list and handle. No partial handle is published on failure.
model.shared_handle_failure: OutOfHandles is separate from thread quota and rolls back its pending reservation.
model.quota_failure: LimitReached before allocation; immediate diagnostic refusal rather than the kernel100ms reservation-wait/hint policy.

limits: 128 is explicit enforced host diagnostic policy, not a Switch title resource-contract measurement.
Only the current native process pseudo handle is supported; no foreign process capability is fabricated.
Immediate quota exhaustion does not implement Horizon100ms reservation waits/hints.
The inherited g_keythr==0 sentinel remains unchanged; actual loader allocates runtime_keys[8] first. Generic zero-key-safe standalone initialization is not claimed.
Existing StartThread activity, scheduler/event behavior and all other SVC semantics are outside this change.
A released guest object may finish native pthread/TLS teardown immediately afterward; this object quota is not a global macOS thread or resident-memory cap.
sanitization: Only source/module hashes, offsets and decoded semantics; no owned instruction bytes, payloads, keys or personal absolute paths.
